    • color

      public int color(String role, String screen, String element, int fallback)
      Finds a role for one control. The caller can cache this result for a theme revision.
      Parameters:
      role - semantic color role
      screen - menu identifier
      element - stable element path within the menu
      fallback - ARGB for a role absent from the base theme
      Returns:
      resolved ARGB color
